verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI code-review service, but nothing in the evidence shows Bugbot itself can be deployed on user infrastructure. Support for GitHub Enterprise Server, GitLab Self-Hosted and Bitbucket Data Center means Bugbot can connect to self-hosted source-control platforms; that is a host-platform capability, not a self-hosted Bugbot. The documented egress proxy is described as hosted by Cursor, so it does not qualify either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
